name: Che
description: '''Chase Shaun Mitchell''' (born August 29, 2006), known professionally as '''Che''', is an American rapper, songwriter, and producer from [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia_(U.S._state)|Georgia]]. He first gained traction in late 2021 through viral tracks on [[TikTok]] and streaming platforms, particularly for his song "Agenda", and later saw additional success in 2024 with "Miley Cyrus" and "[[Pizza Time]]".
